title: Pulse — Ingestion Pipeline Health (S15)
description: The four numbers that ARE the product's health. Panels map 1:1 to PipelineSample (packages/shared/pipeline-health.ts). Datasource-agnostic panel spec; wire the queries to your metrics backend (Prometheus/CH system tables).

panels.title: Ingest rate (events/sec accepted)
panels.note: Customer-visible throughput. This is the count quotas meter from (accepted, not stored).

panels.title: Consumer lag (backlog not yet stored)
panels.note: Lag = delivered-or-pending stream entries minus stored. The number the lag SLO burns against.

panels.title: DLQ depth
panels.note: Any non-zero DLQ is a defect to triage. Replay path: runbooks/dlq-triage.

panels.title: Event-loss ratio (in vs stored, hourly reconcile)
panels.note: The conscience metric. Target 0; alarm > 0.01%. Double-entry: accepted-in vs stored-in-CH.
